name: Knotwork Wood
description: Deep carved timber and aged brass with a feathered blue-steel wind spear.
notes: All layers use a centered 512 x 512 RGBA canvas. The rotating ring deliberately omits letters so the runtime can keep its cardinal glyphs upright.

orientationConventions.ring: The prominent brass index is at 12 o'clock in the source texture. Apply heading only to the rose transform.
orientationConventions.windPointer: The blue spear tip points to 12 o'clock at world bearing 0. The circular boss is centered at (0.5, 0.5); mount it on the rose and apply pure world bearing.
orientationConventions.lubberMarker: Static screen-space layer. The downward point is baked at 12 o'clock and marks the player's facing.
